wholePhysicalScope: The site’s named north street frontage fixes the extent and orientation. The building footprint inside this frontage is estimated from the public photograph.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the continuous public canopy, central projection and three roof forms. Near views add the lettering, window frames and planter pedestals.
limitations: The model covers the public reception frontage from the street. The dimensions and setback of the canopy are architectural estimates, and the low roof shapes immediately behind are simplified.
The exterior is based on the documented 2012 appearance linked in Qualla. Roof spacing, side elevations, planter detail and trim finishes are approximate.
The terrain is independently sampled and unchanged. The grade beneath the façade comes from that source.
